code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated creatinine and chloride, suggesting possible impaired renal function and risk for infection or bone marrow suppression. The low MCV indicates microcytic anemia. Liver enzymes are within or slightly below normal. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended to clarify underlying causes, including possible hypoxic, renal, or hematologic disorders.
